2228-4279-6772.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-6772.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-6772.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1987-3277-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-3277-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1987-3277-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1580-3967-4871-5075.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

141-3125-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
141-3125-6797.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Naru Meha and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1738-7428.notablePrerequisites: Serra Avatar has lifelink and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1738-7428.description:
Deal combat damage using Serra Avatar, doubling your life total due to its lifelink.
At the beginning of your end step, Defiling Daemogoth triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you've lost this turn.

4050-4605-6132-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

7124-7128.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
An opponent cannot block and kill Raging Regisaur.
7124-7128.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Raging Regisaur as attackers.
Raging Regisaur triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1308-3088-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1322-1329-1482.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4050-5220-5447.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4050-5220-5447.notablePrerequisites: You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
4050-5220-5447.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4948-6575.description:
Activate Terra by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
Esper Terra enters with a lore counter on it, triggering its first chapter ability, creating a token copy of Estrid's Invocation with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste and with one to four lore counters on it.
Put the oldest Esper Terra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Estrid's Invocation token's chapter abilities will trigger according to how many lore counters were placed on it.
Resolve the first Estrid's Invocation token trigger, creating a token copy of Estrid's Invocation with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste and with one to four lore counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.
4948-6575.notes: You can stack additional Esper Terra triggers and resolve them later for more tokens and mana.

1329-2178-3652-6797.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-6797.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

856-1808-4231-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

372-1621-5887.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1621-5887.notablePrerequisites: Wispweaver Angel exiled by Werefox Bodyguard
372-1621-5887.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Werefox Bodyguard and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Wispweaver Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Werefox Bodyguard to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Werefox Bodyguard and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Werefox Bodyguard and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-5231-5263.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {R}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding {R}.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.

2366-2757-3129-5702.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
2366-2757-3129-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control at least one basic Forest, or the land card in your hand is a basic Forest.
2366-2757-3129-5702.description:
Play any land from your hand, ensuring to play a basic Forest if you have one in hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Dryad Arbor token, untapping the basic Forest.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 3.

2366-3470-3875-5702.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
2366-3470-3875-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3470-3875-5702.description:
Play any land from your hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko, Tireless Provisioner and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko, Tireless Provisioner and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

2720-4447-4691.description:
At the beginning of an opponent's upkeep, Assault Suit triggers, giving them control of Vilis.
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Underworld Dreams triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library or by having a life total of 0.
When the opponent loses the game, you regain control of Vilis.
Repeat from step 1 for each remaining opponent.

884-1339-2178-2302.notablePrerequisites:
Ayara does not have summoning sickness.
"Black" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Ayara.
884-1339-2178-2302.description:
Activate Ayara by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ayara triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Ayara ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

539-1339-2232-3661-3848.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
539-1339-2232-3661-3848.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Omnath's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control and drawing a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creture token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Shield Sphere from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

673-4068-4803-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control at least one Mountain.
673-4068-4803-5261.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Planar Incision without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Planar Incision, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Wormfang Drake

372-465-1430.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Mirror Image until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mirror Image from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Mirror Image enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Wormfang Drake.
Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1349-2793-4241-4659-4742.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability and Nahiri's Resolve trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Nahiri's Resolve trigger from step 2, exiling Ugin's Nexus until your next upkeep.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Nahiri's Resolve triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1821-4694-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
"Phyrexian" chosen with Conspiracy.
1821-4694-4875.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be a Phyrexian due to Conspiracy.
Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token with two +1/+1 counters on it.
The Incubator enters the battlefield as a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature due to March of the Machines and Conspiracy.
Repeat from step 2.

2342-2796.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat.
